title: The Kindly Bell
author: O. M. Nystrom
blurb: Bram Oyelaran, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
